prompt: Which architect designed the old post office at the corner of Jacques-Cartier and Saint-Jacques streets in Saint-Jean-sur-Richelieu, which was completed in 1909?
answer: The old post office was designed by **J. E. H. Benoît** (Joseph-E.-Alexandre Benoît), an architect from Saint-Jean. It was built around **1906–1909** at the corner of Jacques-Cartier and Saint-Jacques streets.
